items.source: This attribute may not be used in conjunction with factories(), but it may be used instead of factories().
items.translation: 此属性不能与factories()一起使用，但可以作为factories()的替代方案。

items.source: This annotation may be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations. In addition, this annotation will be inherited from an enclosing test class by default. See @NestedTestConfiguration for details.
items.translation: 此注解可用作元注解来创建自定义的组合注解。此外，默认情况下，该注解将从外部测试类继承。有关详细信息，请参阅@NestedTestConfiguration。

items.source: @ContextCustomizerFactories is used to register factories for a particular test class, its subclasses, and its nested classes. If you wish to register a factory globally, you should register it via the automatic discovery mechanism described in ContextCustomizerFactory.
items.translation: @ContextCustomizerFactories 用于为特定的测试类、其子类及其嵌套类注册工厂。如果您希望全局注册一个工厂，则应通过ContextCustomizerFactory中描述的自动发现机制进行注册。

items.source: The default value is true, which means that an annotated class will inherit the factories defined by an annotated superclass or enclosing class. Specifically, the factories for an annotated class will be appended to the list of factories defined by an annotated superclass or enclosing class. Thus, subclasses and nested classes have the option of extending the list of factories.
items.translation: 默认值为 `true`，这意味着一个带注解的类将 继承 由带注解的超类或外部类定义的工厂。具体而言，带注解的类的工厂将被追加到带注解的超类或外部类定义的工厂列表中。因此，子类及内部类有选项可以 扩展 工厂列表。

items.source: If inheritListeners is set to false, the factories for the annotated class will shadow and effectively replace any factories defined by a superclass or enclosing class.
items.translation: 如果将 `inheritListeners` 设置为 `false，则注解类的工厂将 遮蔽 并实际上替换由超类或外部类定义的工厂。

items.source: Can be set to REPLACE_DEFAULTS to have locally declared factories replace the default factories.
items.translation: 可设置为REPLACE_DEFAULTS，以使本地声明的工厂替换默认工厂。

items.source:
The mode is ignored if factories are inherited from a superclass or
enclosing class.
items.translation: 如果工厂是从超类或外部类继承的，则忽略该模式。

items.source: Whether the configured set of factories() from superclasses and enclosing classes should be inherited.
items.translation: 是否应该继承由超类和外围类配置的factories()集合。

items.source: The ContextCustomizerFactory implementations to register.
items.translation: 要注册的 `ContextCustomizerFactory` 实现。

items.source: This attribute may not be used in conjunction with value(), but it may be used instead of value().
items.translation: 此属性不能与value()一起使用，但可以作为value()的替代方案。

items.source: Enumeration of modes that dictate whether explicitly declared factories are merged with the default factories when @ContextCustomizerFactories is declared on a class that does not inherit factories from a superclass or enclosing class.
items.translation: 枚举 modes，用于规定当在类上声明了 @ContextCustomizerFactories 且该类未从父类或外部类继承工厂时，显式声明的工厂是否与默认工厂合并。

items.source: The merge mode to use when @ContextCustomizerFactories is declared on a class that does not inherit factories from a superclass or enclosing class.
items.translation: 当类上声明了 `@ContextCustomizerFactories` 且该类不从父类或外部类继承工厂时，要使用的合并模式。
